prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pearland, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1111; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim file reference. I was the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: Understood. Can you describe where the collision happened?

A: It was in a parking lot in Pearland, Texas, at a shopping center. I was pulling out of a parking space when another vehicle backed into the driver's side of my car.

Q: How fast were you moving at the time?

A: Very slowly, maybe walking speed. I had just started to turn the wheel to get out of the space.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: No. I didn't see it coming. There were a lot of cars around, and I heard a loud bang and felt the car jolt.

Q: Did you hit your head during the collision?

A: I think I hit the side of my head on the window frame. Right after, I felt dizzy and had a headache that got worse over the next few hours.

Q: Have you sought medical attention since the accident?

A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic that evening. They said I had a concussion and told me to rest and avoid screens as much as possible. I'm still having trouble concentrating and I get light-headed when I stand up quickly.

Q: Are you currently under a doctor's care for this?

A: Yes, I have a follow-up scheduled with my primary care physician, and they've referred me to a neurologist.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was following the parking lot traffic pattern and I did nothing unusual before the impact. I'd like the other driver's insurance to know I'm taking this seriously.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
